title: 初二独白：屋顶观测
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
timing_notice: 每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔和重播提示为本机编排
instruction: 听一段独白，完成全部五题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。独白两遍，听前25秒、听后25秒。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Hello, I am Maya, and I would like to tell you about our school weather project. There are twelve students in our team. We started in October, after our geography teacher showed us a notebook kept by a former pupil. It contained weather records from twenty years ago. We wanted to compare them with today's weather. At first we measured the temperature outside the library, but the reading changed whenever someone opened its warm doors. We now use a shaded corner of the roof garden. Two students go there each school day at one o'clock. They read the thermometer and write down the amount of rain. On Fridays, our whole team enters the week's results into a computer. We publish a simple chart once a month on the school website. Our next step is to add wind measurements. A parent has offered to help us build the equipment during the holiday, so we do not have to buy an expensive set.

questions.stem: How many students are in Maya's team?
questions.rationale: A：未说十人；B：是旧记录的年数；C：明确twelve students

questions.stem: What first interested them in the project?
questions.rationale: A：老师展示旧笔记引发比较想法；B：未提电视；C：网站是发布结果用途

questions.stem: Why did they stop measuring outside the library?
options: The library was too far away.
questions.rationale: A：未说屋顶更暖；B：暖门打开改变读数；C：未说距离问题

questions.stem: When do they put results into a computer?
questions.rationale: A：未说周一输入；B：一点是每天测量时间；C：明确周五录入一周结果

questions.stem: What will the team measure next?
questions.rationale: A：未计划积雪测量；B：明确next step wind measurements；C：未测河水
